name: WebGL Mesh Gradient Plasma
description: A flowing WebGL mesh-gradient of color spots that swirl and distort like plasma, for a high-end animated hero canvas.
usage: Wrap your hero content in <MeshGradientPlasma> to lay a live GLSL plasma canvas behind it; tune colors, speed, distortion, swirl, grainMixer and grainOverlay to taste. It freezes on a still frame automatically when prefers-reduced-motion is set.
